name: Agent
author: Omarchy
description: Ask Omarchy's default agent to work with this folder or selection, with Synchro catalog access.

action.exec: omarchy agent prompt "Work with the current Synchro file-browser context. Start by reading the JSON selection manifest named by the SYNCHRO_SELECTION environment variable. Your working folder is %d. Use synchro query --help for read-only access to Synchro's persistent indexed metadata, saved SQL folders, and deterministic file facts."
